One-line description: B2B restocking app with short-term credit for small-town kirana stores.
Equity split: Founders 85%, angels 15%. ESOP pool to be created.
What have you built?: A vernacular Android app for store owners to order from partner distributors, with next-morning delivery and 7 to 14 days credit for repeat customers. Live in Karimnagar only.
Active customers: 42 retailers onboarded, 22 of whom have ordered more than once.
Revenue / GMV: GMV of about INR 9 lakh in the last three months. Revenue is trade margin of about 4% plus a credit fee on credit orders.
Growth: GMV has grown every month since the July launch.
Repeat behaviour: Repeat customers reorder about once a week.
Customer acquisition: Two field agents visit stores and onboard them. Word of mouth between neighbouring stores has helped. Our CAC is under INR 2,000 per store.
Unit economics: Positive contribution on delivered orders once a store has ordered twice.
How is credit funded?: Credit is provided through our NBFC partner. We take the first-loss risk.
Defaults to date: None so far. We follow up personally on late payments.
Who else is doing this?: Large B2B marketplaces and local wholesale markets.
Why will you win?: We focus only on small towns and speak the owner's language, literally and in how we assess credit.
Existing investors: Three angels from the FMCG and logistics industry, INR 25 lakh in total.
Use of funds: Credit book, hiring, expansion to two more towns.
Other investors in conversation: One pre-seed fund. No term sheet yet.
How did you hear about us?: Introduction through a founder in your Fund I portfolio.
Anything else we should know?: We have been told our credit-scoring approach is an edge. Happy to walk you through it on a call. We would also welcome your help with introductions to NBFCs.
Founder background: Aarav Deshmukh (CEO Background: FMCG distribution and field operations, 8 years): Ran a regional sales team at a large distributor. Pooja Nair (CTO Background: Software engineer at a payments company, 5 years): Built the ordering app and our credit-scoring rules.
